text:
maria: Heads up — APAC prod account just hit the public IPv4 allocation limit. We're blocked from provisioning more ENIs for the new GPU dedicated pool. Need quota increases (EIPs + ENIs) in ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1 by tomorrow morning for the launch. Anyone can open tickets with AWS?
chris: Oof. How many addresses/ENIs do we need exactly?
maria: Rough numbers: ap-southeast-1: +600 ENIs, +300 EIPs. ap-northeast-1: +300 ENIs, +150 EIPs. These are for new p4d-style node pools across 3 accounts: acct-111111111111, acct-222222222222, acct-333333333333.
kai: Do we need EIPs for each node or can we NAT?
maria: We need EIPs for some pools for inbound diagnostics and support tooling (we have a dependency on static IPs for whitelisting customer endpoints). Other pools can go behind NAT. This request is specifically for the fronting/public node pool.
sophie: Raising a bunch of EIPs will spike costs (EIP hourly charge when unattached). Can we reduce count by using Elastic Network Interfaces + secondary private IPs + a small fleet of NAT gateways?
maria: We've already trimmed where possible. The product team insists on a set of static IPs per AZ for troubleshooting. They want 100 static IPs per AZ in APAC for now.
chris: OK. I'll open the AWS support requests. Can you paste the support description you want me to use?
maria: Copy-paste this for each account/region: 
```
Summary: Request increase of Elastic IP and ENI quotas for dedicated GPU pools (production)
Account ID: <account-id>
Region: <region> (ap-southeast-1 / ap-northeast-1)
Resources: +ENI limit to X (from current) and +Elastic IPs to Y
Reason: We are deploying dedicated GPU node pools for latency-sensitive inference. Each node requires a public IP for inbound debugging/whitelisting and to integrate with on-call diagnostics. Launch schedule: 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC. Please expedite — outage risk if not approved.
Contact: maria@redwood.com, chris@redwood.com
```
chris: Nice. I'll submit now and link here.
quota-bot: [quota request created] Ticket #542189 — AWS support case opened for acct-111111111111 ap-southeast-1 (EIP+ENI). ETA 48-72h.
kai: If AWS pushes back on EIPs, we should offer IPv6 fallback for internal tooling — less pressure on scarce IPv4. Can we enable IPv6 in those VPCs without breaking anything?
sophie: IPv6 would help for outbound, but many third-party vendor integrations still require IPv4 for allowlists. Also ALB/ingress config needs testing. Not a drop-in.
maria: Agreed. IPv6 is a medium-term mitigation. For now we need the EIP/ENI increases.
chris: All tickets submitted: acct-111... #542189, acct-222... #542190, acct-333... #542191. I'll escalate to TAM and mark high-priority. Linking the support threads: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home#/case/?caseId=542189 (posted)
maria: Thanks — I'll notify product and postpone any further launches until we have approvals. :pray:
kai: Also filing a tech task to add IPv6 enablement backlog item: ENGINFRA-3284. If quotas take too long, we might temporarily reduce AZ distribution to fit current limits.
sophie: FYI finance flagged potential additional EIP costs. @maria we'll need an estimate for the monthly EIP expense to include in the launch deck.
maria: Will do — quick estimate: ~450 reserved EIPs across APAC -> ~$1.2k/month (rough). I'll send exact calc after approvals.
chris: Monitoring support responses, will update this thread. :thumbsup:
